title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built

translated_title: RelationVGGT：用于三维空间关系分割的视觉几何Transformer
translated_abstract: 三维重建领域的最新进展已从逐场景优化发展到前馈推理，语义场景理解也随之跟进——然而现有方法仍局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽视了物体之间的空间关系。我们在前馈、无位姿的多视角设置下提出了三维空间关系分割这一任务：给定一个通过视觉指定的主体和一个关系文本查询，模型无需获知目标的类别名称即可跨视角分割出目标。为此，我们提出了RelationVGGT，这是一个新颖的前馈框架，它将视觉基础模型的语义特征与三维几何基础模型的几何感知表示相融合，并利用关系Transformer进行以主体为条件的跨视角关系预测——既不需要逐场景优化，也不需要已知的相机位姿。此外，我们还提供了一个完全自动化的标注流水线（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了RelationVGGT框架，通过融合视觉基础模型的语义特征与三维几何基础模型的几何感知表示，实现了无需相机位姿、无需逐场景优化的前馈式多视角三维空间关系分割。
en_tdlr: RelationVGGT is a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model, enabling pose-free 3D spatial relation segmentation across multiple views without per-scene optimization.
